mixerTooltip: Monitor audio levels. If the bars are moving you are outputting audio.
loudnessHidden: You can show the loudness panel again under Settings → General.
loudnessTooltip: Perceived loudness of the stream audio (last 3 seconds, EBU R 128). Use the menu to change the target.

loudnessAdjust.title: Auto-adjust volume
loudnessAdjust.selectMessage:
Choose the source to adjust.
Its volume is measured for a few seconds and adjusted automatically toward the target.
loudnessAdjust.noSource: No audio source to adjust (an unmuted source is required).
loudnessAdjust.pauseNote: Speak naturally, pausing between words. Holding a single sound such as "ahh" cannot be detected as a voice.
loudnessAdjust.speakNote: Speak into the microphone during the measurement, as you would while streaming.
loudnessAdjust.measuring: Measuring. Please speak into the microphone...
loudnessAdjust.silent:
No voice was detected.
Please try again while speaking into the microphone.
loudnessAdjust.resultGain:
Gain set to {gain} dB.
You can fine-tune it later in the source's filters.
loudnessAdjust.resultGainDown:
Gain lowered to {gain} dB.
You can fine-tune it later in the source's filters.
loudnessAdjust.resultNone: The volume is already close to the target, so nothing was changed.
loudnessAdjust.limited: The gain limit was reached. To make it louder, raise the microphone input volume in Windows sound settings.
